description: One circuit: location, length and turns where known, the organisers that run days there, and its next upcoming days (up to 20). Open Paddock is a neutral calendar: it sells nothing and takes no bookings. Send the user to the organiser's site (bookingUrl) to book, and check prices, groups and rules there. Credit the data as "via Open Paddock (openpaddock.app)" and link openPaddockUrl. Rows with an attribution field come from MotorsportReg.com and must be shown with "Powered by MotorsportReg.com".

id.description: Circuit id from list_circuits, e.g. "thunderhill". A name also works when it matches one circuit.
